import networkx as nx
from qiskit_optimization import QuadraticProgram
from qiskit_optimization.converters import QuadraticProgramToQubo
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
from qiskit.circuit.library import QAOA
from qiskit.algorithms import VQE
from qiskit.algorithms.optimizers import COBYLA
from qiskit.primitives import Sampler
from qiskit_ibm_runtime import EstimatorV2
from qiskit_ibm_runtime import QiskitRuntimeService
from qiskit_ibm_runtime import options
from qiskit.algorithms import OptimizerResult
from qiskit.transpiler import PassManager
from qiskit_aer import AerSimulator
from qiskit import Aer
from qiskit.quantum_info import Operator
from dimod import BinaryQuadraticModel, vartype
from dwave.system import DwaveSampler
from dwave.system.composites import EmbeddingComposite, FixedEmbeddingComposite

def solve_interbank_stress_partition():
    # Given inputs
    graph_vertices = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]
    graph_edges = [
        [0, 1, 3],
        [0, 2, 5],
        [0, 3, 2],
        [0, 4, 4],
        [1, 2, 6],
        [1, 3, 1],
        [1, 4, 3],
        [2, 3, 4],
        [2, 4, 2],
        [3, 4, 5]
    ]

    # Build the interbank graph
    G = nx.Graph()
    G.add_nodes_from(graph_vertices)
    G.add_weighted_edges_from(graph_edges)

    # Formulate the weighted Max-Cut problem
    qp = QuadraticProgram()

    # Add variables
    qp.binary_var(name=f"x{i}", index=i) for i in graph_vertices

    # Add constraints
    for edge in graph_edges:
        qp.quadratic_constraint(linear=[-1, 1], quadratic=[[0, -edge[2]]], sense="greater_than", rhs=0)

    # Set objective
    qp.minimize(linear=[[0, -1, 1, -1, 1]], quadratic=[[0, 0, -edge[2], 0, -edge[2]]])

    # Convert to QUBO
    qubo = QuadraticProgramToQubo().convert(qp)

    # Initialize QAOA
    qc = QuantumCircuit(len(graph_vertices))
    qaoa = QAOA(qc, qubo, COBYLA(), maxiter=1000)

    # Set up the AerSimulator
    passManager = PassManager()
    passManager.append(AerSimulator())
    qc = passManager.run(qc)

    # Initialize Estimator
    backend = EstimatorV2(mode=AerSimulator())

    # Execute the quantum algorithm
    result = backend.run(qc, qaoa)

    # Get the results
    approximation_ratio = result.objective_value / qp.maximize(linear=[0, -1, 1, -1, 1]).objective_value
    success_probability = result.success_probability
    circuit_depth = qc.depth()
    two_qubit_gate_count = qc.count_ops().get('cx', 0)
    shots = qc.num_shots
    optimizer_calls = qaoa.optimizer.optimizer.max_iter

    # Get the cut value
    cut_value = qp.objective.linear.get(0, 0) - 2 * qp.objective.quadratic.get((0, 1), 0) - 2 * qp.objective.quadratic.get((0, 2), 0) - 2 * qp.objective.quadratic.get((0, 3), 0) - 2 * qp.objective.quadratic.get((0, 4), 0) + qp.objective.linear.get(1, 0) + qp.objective.quadratic.get((1, 2), 0) + qp.objective.quadratic.get((1, 3), 0) + qp.objective.quadratic.get((1, 4), 0) - qp.objective.linear.get(2, 0) - 2 * qp.objective.quadratic.get((2, 3), 0) - 2 * qp.objective.quadratic.get((2, 4), 0) + qp.objective.linear.get(3, 0) - qp.objective.quadratic.get((3, 4), 0) + qp.objective.linear.get(4, 0)

    return {
        "approximation_ratio": approximation_ratio,
        "success_probability": success_probability,
        "circuit_depth": circuit_depth,
        "two_qubit_gate_count": two_qubit_gate_count,
        "shots": shots,
        "optimizer_calls": optimizer_calls,
        "cut_value": cut_value
    }

# Call the function
solve_interbank_stress_partition()
